name: Etrata
description: Etrata is a vampire Dimir assassin on Ravnica who becomes the assistant of the detective Alquist Proft.

summary.text: Etrata is a vampire Dimir assassin on Ravnica who becomes the assistant of the detective Alquist Proft.

bio.text: Disguised in Selesnya colors at Karlov Manor, she bares vampire fangs and flees when Proft confronts her, but Kellan restrains her and she is taken into Azorius custody.
